name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 10 - Am 111
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 10 a. Stresses the need to undertake a structural and objective reassessment of the network of the Union’s decentralised agencies; considers that the proliferation of such entities results in administrative fragmentation, overlaps in competences and disproportionate operating costs; calls for the abolition of agencies whose operational and budgetary relevance remain insufficient, with a view to reallocating the corresponding resources;
